input.free_text_description: The system operates in the authentication, scheduling domain. It serves API Consumer, Admin, System, User as its primary actors. The main business capabilities include admin, admin_role_relation, comments. Core business data revolves around MemberReadHistory, Role_resource_relation, TermRelationships, User. The system enforces access control and identity verification for protected operations.

user_stories.story: As a API Consumer, I want to comment on posts, so that I can participate in discussions and provide feedback.
As a API Consumer, I want to create and browse posts, so that I can share content and discover what others have published.
As a API Consumer, I want to browse and apply for job postings, so that I can find employment opportunities matching my skills.
As a Admin, I want to schedule automated jobs, so that recurring operations run on time without manual intervention.
As a Admin, I want to organize items into categories, so that users can easily navigate and filter available items.
